verdict.rationale: Compute placement is a fair question for a cloud application platform like Render, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents automatic placement of compute near backend data. The global CDN (render-docs-19) only caches static assets and the private network (render-docs-10) only keeps internal traffic off the public internet; both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
